question: Will Bitcoin be above $64,500 on Binance at 7:59 PM EDT on August 14?

model.prompt_context: This market resolves based on the price of Bitcoin in USDT on the Binance spot market (BTCUSDT). The reference price is the close price of the Binance BTCUSDT 1-minute kline with open time 23:58:00 UTC on August 14, 2026 (7:58:00 PM EDT) — the last fully completed 1-minute candle as of the 7:59 PM EDT observation time. Resolves to "Yes" if that close price is strictly greater than 64,500.00 USDT. Resolves to "No" if it is equal to or less than 64,500.00 USDT. If the Binance API reports no kline for that minute (e.g., exchange downtime), the reference price is the close of the nearest preceding completed BTCUSDT 1-minute kline.
